_comment: Mount Hermon corrections. IDS ARE FROM THE CURRENT `npm run data` BUILD; `data:refresh` renumbers nodes and will break these. (1) DEM-flat cable-car 2 (רכבל 2) stations both sampled at 1689 m; real bottom 1640 / top 1720. (2) The confluence where black #2 / red #3 / blue #6 meet (n40/n54/n66/n55/n1/n51) was over-sampled at 1736-1745 m — above the lift-2 top — which reversed blue #6; real junction is ~1710 m, so blue #6 now descends from the lift-2 top into it. (3) The central T-bar top (n24) skis out only via 4A in OSM but really also drops onto red Piste 12 at its nearest point (n5) — add that skiable connector. (4) רכבל מבקרים is a foot-passenger sightseeing gondola, not a ski lift — remove it from routing (the summit is still served by רכבל חדש / רכבל 7 / שיאון). (5) Piste 3A's long upper segment (n15→n23, ~720 m) was DEM-sampled with only a 3 m endpoint drop (noisy 1896-1998 m samples) so it became a dashed 2-way flat link; it is really a mellow descent. Raise its top n15 to ~1990 m so it re-derives as a one-way ~49 m descent.
